mapper.select:
SELECT B.BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.WRITER, B.ATCH_FILE_ID, B.REG_DT, B.UPD_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTACH_FILE_DETAIL D WHERE D.ATCH_FILE_ID = B.ATCH_FILE_ID) AS FILE_CNT FROM BOARD B WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY B.REG_DT DESC, B.BOARD_ID DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (BOARD_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER, ATCH_FILE_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{atchFileId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, WRITER = #{writer}, ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId}, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
